episodes.title: Are Mum's Groups a Cult? w/ Jorjia Gillis
episodes.description:
For today's episode, we're joined by proud Budawang & Yuin playwright Jorjia Gillis. We chat about the real life experiences that have inspired her new play Mum Club. We talk about becoming a mum, finding connection when you feel completely alone, and turning the weird, funny and often uncomfortable parts of motherhood into art.

We get into birth trauma, mum competition, unsolicited advice, WhatsApp group politics, and why sometimes the only way through motherhood is to admit how fucking absurd it all is.

Get tickets to Mum Club here: https://griffintheatre.com.au/whats-on/mum-club/

episodes.title: My Ex Was Jailed for Coercive Control w/ Sammie
episodes.description:
Sammie's ex became the first person in NSW to be jailed for coercive control. In this episode, she shares her powerful story, and gives us incredible insight into the realities of surviving in an abusive relationship.
We get honest about:
• How the relationship began, escalated, and ultimately led to Australia's first coercive control conviction in NSW
• Why victims often return to abusive relationships, even when they know they should leave
• Trauma bonds, how they form, and what it takes to break them
• What family and friends saw from the outside, and how much was happening behind closed doors
• Financial and sexual coercion, and why these forms of abuse are so often misunderstood
• The difference between a healthy relationship and a coercively controlling one, even when the behaviours can look similar
• Red flags to watch for in your own relationships and those around you
Everything the relationship stole (and continues to steal) from her
• Sam's reflections, and looking forward
